rows.q: My mobile internet is really slow, what can I do?
rows.answer:
Slow internet can be caused by congestion, low signal, or using up your high-speed data allowance. Try these steps:
1. Toggle airplane mode off and on to force a network reconnect.
2. Check if you have reached your high-speed data cap; after it’s used, speed is throttled to 512 kbps (standard plans) or 1 Mbps (premium). 
3. If you’re in a low-signal area, move to a location with better coverage.
4. If the issue persists during peak hours, it may be network congestion; consider using data at off-peak times or contact an agent for further help.

rows.q: How do I check how much data I have left?
rows.answer: You can check your remaining data balance by dialing *123# on your phone, or by opening the MyTelecom app, tapping My Usage and viewing the dashboard.

rows.q: What happens when I use up my high-speed data?
rows.answer: When you reach the high-speed data allowance in your plan, your connection is throttled for the rest of the billing cycle. Standard plans drop to about 512 kbps, while premium plans go to about 1 Mbps. You’ll still have internet access, but it won’t support video streaming or large downloads.

rows.q: Why is my bill higher than usual?
rows.answer: Common reasons for a higher bill include international roaming charges, premium SMS subscriptions, a plan change, or additional data packs purchased mid-cycle. To see a full breakdown of your charges, go to Billing > Itemised Bill in the app.

rows.q: When is my bill due?
rows.answer: Your bill is generated on your monthly anniversary date and payment is due 14 days later. You can see the exact due date in the MyTelecom app under Billing > Current Bill.

rows.q: How do I download an itemised bill?
rows.answer: Log in to MyTelecom, go to Billing > Download Bill, and select the PDF option. The PDF will contain the itemised bill showing each call, SMS and data session with date, time and cost. Bills are available for the last 12 months.

rows.q: If I upgrade my plan mid-month how am I billed?
rows.answer: If you upgrade your plan mid-month, the new plan won’t take effect until the start of your next billing cycle, and you’ll be billed the full price of the new plan at that time. The current month’s bill remains based on your existing plan.

rows.q: How do I set up autopay?
rows.answer:
1. Open the MyTelecom app.
2. Go to Billing > Payment Methods.
3. Add a credit or debit card.
4. Enable AutoPay.
You’ll get an SMS reminder 3 days before each payment is taken.

rows.q: There's a charge for some SMS subscription I never signed up for
rows.answer: It looks like the charge is for a premium SMS subscription. These are third-party services that can bill through NovaCell and sometimes are added unintentionally via click-to-subscribe links. You can review the charge in your itemised bill (Billing > Itemised Bill in the app) and, if it’s not yours, raise a dispute with us. An agent can then investigate and resolve the issue.

rows.q: How long does it take for a new SIM to activate?
rows.answer: A new SIM card usually activates within 15 minutes after you insert it. If it’s still not active after an hour, try restarting your phone; if it remains inactive, call 611 and provide the SIM serial number printed on the card.

rows.q: My eSIM QR code keeps failing to scan
rows.answer: If the QR code won’t scan, it may have already been used. Each eSIM QR code can be used only once, so stop retrying the same code. Request a new activation code or QR code via live chat in the MyTelecom app or by calling 611, then scan the fresh code while connected to Wi-Fi.

rows.q: Phone says SIM not detected after I restarted it
rows.answer:
1. Power off your phone.
2. Remove the SIM card and reseat it firmly.
3. Power the phone back on.
If the problem continues, try the SIM in another phone to see if the SIM is damaged. If the SIM works elsewhere, the phone’s SIM tray or slot may be faulty.

rows.q: Can I keep my number if I switch to NovaCell?
rows.answer: Yes, you can keep your number. Number porting is free and typically finishes within about 2 hours on working days. To start the port, call 611 or visit a NovaCell store and keep your old SIM active until you receive an SMS confirming the port is complete.

rows.q: My SIM was stolen, what do I do?
rows.answer:
1. Call 611 immediately to report the theft and have the SIM blocked.
2. Go to any NovaCell store with a valid photo ID.
3. Request a replacement SIM; a $5 fee applies.
4. Your phone number and plan will be transferred to the new SIM automatically.

rows.q: How do I turn on international roaming?
rows.answer:
1. Open the MyTelecom app.
2. Go to Plan & Services > International Roaming.
3. Toggle the roaming switch on (do this at least 24 hours before you travel).
4. Choose a roaming bundle to avoid per-MB charges.
5. Roaming will turn off automatically when you return home.
If you prefer, you can also enable roaming by calling 611.

rows.q: I have no signal at all in Tokyo even though roaming is on
rows.answer: It sounds like your account’s roaming permissions may not cover Japan. We’ll need to update your roaming settings to include the Asia-Pacific region and add a Japan daily bundle if you’d like. In the meantime, you can verify that your phone is set to automatic network selection (Settings > Mobile Network > Network Selection > Automatic). An agent can make the necessary changes and confirm coverage for Tokyo.

rows.q: How much does the International Day Pass cost?
rows.answer: The International Day Pass costs $10 per day, per line.

rows.q: I got roaming charges even though I bought a bundle
rows.answer: If you used data or made calls abroad before the roaming bundle was active, those minutes/MB are billed at the standard roaming rates and aren’t refunded when the bundle starts later that day. Your itemised bill in the app shows the activation time and the first usage abroad. If you think the bundle should have covered that usage, contact support on 611 so an agent can review it.

rows.q: Why can't I make international calls?
rows.answer:
International calls are blocked because the International Calling add-on isn’t enabled on your account. To enable it:
1. Log in to the NovaCell portal.
2. Go to Add-ons > International Calling.
3. Activate the International Calling Pack (adds discounted rates and unlimited landline calls to included countries).

rows.q: My calls keep dropping
rows.answer:
Call drops are usually due to weak signal, SIM issues, or device antenna problems. Try these steps:
1. Restart your phone.
2. Reseat the SIM card.
3. If possible, test with another SIM.
4. Check for any network outages in the NovaCell app.

rows.q: How do I turn on Wi-Fi calling?
rows.answer:
1. Open Settings on your phone.
2. Tap Phone.
3. Select Wi-Fi Calling.
4. Toggle the switch to turn it on.
Make sure your plan includes Wi-Fi calling; otherwise call 611 to add it.

rows.q: All my incoming calls go straight to voicemail
rows.answer: It looks like call barring may have been turned on, which sends all incoming calls straight to voicemail. Please check your account’s Call Barring settings in the portal or call 611 to have an agent review and disable it if needed.

rows.q: I hear an echo of my own voice on calls
rows.answer: It sounds like the echo is caused by a mis-configured echo-cancellation setting, which can be corrected remotely by an agent. Please contact support so they can re-configure the setting and verify the issue is resolved.

rows.q: What is VoLTE and how do I enable it?
rows.answer: VoLTE (Voice over LTE) provides HD voice calls over the 4G network. Enable it via Settings > Mobile Network > VoLTE. Your device and SIM must support VoLTE; if the option is greyed out call 611 to check compatibility.

rows.q: How do I contact customer support?
rows.answer: You can reach us by calling 611 (free from your mobile), using live chat in the MyTelecom app (available 8 am-10 pm), emailing support@telecom.example.com, or visiting any of our retail stores. Average call wait time is under 3 minutes.

rows.q: I forgot my app password and the reset email never arrives
rows.answer:
1. Open the MyTelecom app and tap "Forgot password".
2. Enter the email address linked to your account.
3. Check your inbox (and spam folder) for the reset email.
If you don’t receive it, the reset may be sent to an old email address on file. Contact support to verify your identity, update your email, and have them trigger a new reset email.
You can reach support by calling 611, using live chat in the app, emailing support@telecom.example.com, or visiting a store.

rows.q: How do I unlock my phone to use another network?
rows.answer: Phones bought from us unlock after 60 days or once fully paid. To request an unlock, go to MyTelecom > Device > Request Unlock, or call 611. Unlocking is free.

rows.q: What's the cheapest prepaid plan?
rows.answer: The cheapest prepaid option is the NovaCell Starter 5 plan, which costs $15 per month and includes 5 GB of data, unlimited talk and text, and no contract.

rows.q: How much is the family plan and is there a deal for new accounts?
rows.answer: The Family Unlimited plan (4 lines) costs $140 per month – that’s $35 per line. New accounts get an introductory offer: the first 3 months are 20% off.
